"% Clear workspace
clear; clc;

% --- Aircraft Parameters ---
W = 230000.0;      % Weight [lbf]
S = 2400.0;        % Wing Area [ft^2]
h = 31000.0;       % Altitude [ft]
V = 730.0;         % True Airspeed [ft/s]

% --- Aerodynamic Model ---
CL0 = 0.15;        % Zero-alpha lift coefficient
CLalpha = 5.2;     % Lift curve slope [1/rad]
CD0 = 0.021;       % Zero-lift drag coefficient
k = 0.043;         % Induced drag factor

% --- Atmosphere Model ---
rho0 = 0.0023769;  % Sea level air density [slug/ft^3]
H = 23800.0;       % Scale height [ft]

% --- Engine Model (for context, though specific throttle not requested) ---
% T0 = 62000.0;    % Reference thrust [lbf]
% V0 = 730.0;      % Reference velocity [ft/s]

% --- Calculations ---

% 1. Atmosphere
rho = rho0 * exp(-h / H);      % Density at altitude h
qbar = 0.5 * rho * V^2;        % Dynamic pressure

% 2. Longinal Equilibrium: Lift = Weight
% L = qbar * S * CL = W
CL_trim = W / (qbar * S);

% 3. Solve for Angle of Attack
% CL = CL0 + CLalpha * alpha
alpha_rad = (CL_trim - CL0) / CLalpha;
alpha_deg = rad2deg(alpha_rad);

% 4. Longitudinal Equilibrium: Thrust = Drag
% Drag Polar: CD = CD0 + k * CL^2
CD_trim = CD0 + k * (CL_trim^2);

% Thrust Required = Drag
% D = qbar * S * CD
thrust_req = qbar * S * CD_trim;

% --- Output Generation ---

% Construct result structure
result.alpha_trim_deg = alpha_deg;
result.thrust_lbf = thrust_req;

% Write to JSON file
jsonStr = jsonencode(result);
fid = fopen('result.json', 'w');
fprintf(fid, '%s', jsonStr);
fclose(fid);"
